brief:
Israeli naval forces fired on tents sheltering displaced Palestinians in Gaza, injuring seven people including two children, Al Jazeera reported citing Turkey's Anadolu agency. The attack struck an encampment housing civilians displaced by the ongoing conflict in the territory.

The incident marks the latest in a series of Israeli military operations affecting Gaza's civilian population. Displacement camps have become a focal point of the conflict, with thousands of Palestinians seeking refuge in makeshift shelters across the territory as fighting continues. Medical and humanitarian resources remain strained as injuries mount among vulnerable populations already displaced by the violence.
